scope: Profile, avatar, password/session lifecycle and project team management
changes: Invited members can edit their own profile/security without creating a business
Existing active members return to Dashboard after login
Already-active project members cannot receive redundant invitations
Settings, avatar and operation forms guard synchronous duplicate submissions
Team removal and invitation revocation require confirmation
Current session is labeled and password/session actions reload current session metadata
Password inputs clear after a successful change; native forms use POST
Malformed success responses show errors and preserve drafts

api: Concurrent invitation accept returns 200/409 and does not duplicate membership
Wrong recipient, expired and revoked invitations cannot be accepted
Declining an invitation creates no membership
Session responses exclude tokens and identify the current session
Attempt to delete another account's session does not revoke it
Wrong current password leaves sessions intact
Password change revokes old sessions and issues a valid replacement cookie
browser: Profile double submit sends one PATCH and saved name survives reload
PNG upload is converted and can be removed
Other-device session becomes unauthorized after revocation
Password change clears fields and preserves the rotated browser session
Invited developer reaches Dashboard and personal settings without owner tabs
Team double submit sends one invitation request
Dismissed revoke confirmation sends no mutation; accepted confirmation revokes
Removing a member ends its API access
Settings and team do not overflow at 1440/768/390
Malformed profile success response preserves draft and supports a real retry

limitations: All writes used a disposable loopback test database
No external invitation email was sent; existing in-app invitation behavior retained
No production changes or Git push performed

production.authenticatedFlows: verified locally; not repeated against production
